name_reason: Convention-compliant (fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>), no address residue, accurately describes opening a cross-shape settings-style dialog with a slide-in animation. Part of a consistent naming triplet (fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_close_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_settings_menu_input_step / fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders). Although also reused by item-command and inline-action menus, 'settings' captures the shared cross-shape settings-style dialog widget; renaming would needlessly break the matched open/close/input family for no semantic gain.
purpose: Open the 4-corner (cross-shape) settings-style dialog at the cursor cell with a 4-frame outward-spread slide-in animation.
logic_summary: Saves the char under the cursor (saved_char_idx) for later restamp; computes panel_anchor inside the work buffer from data_fd2_battle_cursor_screen_x/y; seeds 4 corner offsets to 0x390. Plays the open chime (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle on the FDOTHER sfx bank, sfx 8), ticks the chapter palette, pre-renders the battle base scene (fd2_composite_battle_tile_map + fd2_composite_all_chars_overlay), draws the terrain-info HUD, and backs up the dialog area. Over 4 frames it spreads the corners outward (corner[0]-=0x8E8, corner[1]-=6, corner[2]+=6, corner[3]+=0x8E8), restores the dialog backup, then blits the 4 corner sprites: per-corner atlas index = menu_options[c]*3 + menu_state[c]*2, used to look up a dword offset in the dialog-state handle's offset table; sprite_addr = handle + that offset; blitted at panel_anchor + corner_offsets[c]. If a char was under the cursor it is restamped, then the dialog region is flushed to screen via fd2_blit_rectangle. Counterpart: fd2_close_settings_dialog_with_slide @ 0x176B4 (inward-converge close).

params.name: menu_options
params.semantics: 4-int array of per-slot label/option token IDs (e.g. BGM/SE/Speed/Other labels, or item-command / inline-action labels), multiplied by 3 to form the sprite atlas index. In Ghidra still param_1 (unnamed).
params.reason: Ghidra param is still param_1 (generic placeholder, no semantic meaning). The src already uses menu_options, matching the *3 role and the role used by siblings; Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra param to menu_options.

params.name: menu_state
params.semantics: 4-int per-slot state / disable array indexed by direction (Up/Left/Right/Down = slot 0/1/2/3), multiplied by 2 in the sprite atlas index; 0 = slot enabled, non-zero = disabled (matches fd2_settings_menu_input_step). In Ghidra still param_2 (unnamed).
params.reason: Ghidra param is still param_2 (generic placeholder). The src already uses menu_state, matching the *2 role and the disable-mask role used by fd2_settings_menu_input_step / fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders; Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra param to menu_state.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is the rendered slide-in dialog and the backed-up dialog area.

notes: Source comment block (menucfg.c lines 92-117) is already accurate, concise, ASCII, and consistent with the Ghidra plate; left unchanged (comment_verdict=keep, plate=none). Ghidra params are still param_1/param_2 (unnamed) so both are flagged rename->menu_options/menu_state for Stage 2; the src declaration already uses these names. Name kept to preserve the open/close/input/repaint settings-dialog naming family. No logic touched.
